purpose: Reproduce the rejected server-side APM candidate without opening a microphone, playing audio, or calling Eva/providers.
dependencies: Only NumPy, PyAV, LiveKit RTC and the bundled Silero model already present in the speaker image; no package installation or automatic download.

installedInputs.note: Hashes are recorded in every output. A different greeting or model is a different measurement.

fixedReplay.nonlinearCase: Clip playback waveform to +/-2200 before the echo path; reference remains original output.
fixedReplay.output: Twelve fixed combinations; event timings, RMS and input/code/model hashes only. No audio or transcript saved. Exit zero means measurement completed, not candidate accepted.

acceptanceBoundaries: Echo-only speech detection or a missed/delayed soft interruption excludes enabling this candidate in production.
Passing this synthetic replay alone does not prove first-word recognition, physical echo cancellation or ordinary barge-in.
Production reference timing, clipping/AGC, STOP/FINISHED receipt boundaries, stale frames, reconnection and missing metadata still require evidence before replacing the guard.

physicalFollowup.existingManualMechanism: The owner's normal local wakeword conversation and separate STOP/MUTE controls. Existing source diagnostics record lifecycle timing but not paired microphone/reference PCM.
physicalFollowup.missingMechanism: No reviewed passive paired-PCM export was established in this task. This harness has no device access or capture/playback mode.
nextEvidence: Coordinator agrees a short explicit measurement window and device with the owner; no unattended household capture.

Keep the installed echo guard active. If an existing reviewed manual export mechanism is identified, bind capture and render reference to one authorized session, packet sequence and monotone clock, with a fixed maximum duration and local STOP ending capture.
Compare output-only echo, a normal early interruption and a soft early interruption at the actual installed volume; include first consonants and a post-STOP utterance.
Measure capture/render delay, clipping and residual echo before selecting a firmware/channel or software change. Queue acceptance is not proof of DAC timing.
Any explicitly authorized raw measurement stays in a private temporary directory (0700, files 0600); publish only sanitized metrics, never household speech, credentials or device identifiers.
